name: G2 (Genie G2)
dof_breakdown: 26 base (7-DoF force-controlled arms); ~50 with optional 12-DoF dexterous hands
summary: AgiBot's wheeled industrial humanoid, launched in October 2025: Jetson Thor compute, hot-swappable batteries and automatic docking for round-the-clock shifts. In November 2026 six G2s ran a convenience store live for 24 hours. The heavier G2 Max (Oct 2026) lifts 40 kg with both arms across a 0.1–2.5 m working height.
